name: schedule-stale-query-options
description: stale with type [pull_request], label match/ignore and ignore_drafts/milestones/projects: query string built from all options; nothing found.

files..github/mergeable.yml:
version: 2
mergeable:
  - when: schedule.repository
    name: Stale
    validate:
      - do: stale
        days: 10
        type: [pull_request]
        label:
          match: ['needs-review']
          ignore: ['pinned', 'security']
        ignore_drafts: true
        ignore_milestones: true
        ignore_projects: true
    pass:
      - do: comment
        payload:
          body: stale

query.q: repo:acme/app is:open updated:<<timestamp> type:pr label:"needs-review" -label:"pinned" -label:"security" -is:draft no:milestone no:project
